title: When official accounts get hacked
takeaway: When an official account suddenly posts a rushed or too good link, wait and check it on another official channel first.

cards.title: It is the real account
cards.body: You open X and see a post from the real Pocket Dragons account. It says a surprise mint just opened and closes in 30 minutes. The link is new. You have never seen it before. The account is real. But is the link?

seg.label: Surprise mint
seg.why: A mint that was never announced before.

seg.label: Rush
seg.why: A rush is there to stop you checking.

seg.label: New link
seg.why: A link never seen on other official channels.

seg.label: Thanks
seg.why: Kind words are normal and prove nothing.

cards.title: It has happened before
cards.body: Real project accounts have been hacked to post fake mint links. In April 2022 the BAYC Discord was briefly taken over. In May 2022 the OpenSea Discord posted a fake mint pass link. In 2021 hackers took over the Discord of an Animoca Brands game and ran a fake mint, and Animoca pledged to repay 265 ETH.

cards.title: Signs of a hijacked post
cards.body: A hacked account still looks real. The post gives it away: a surprise mint, a rush, a link you never saw. The official mint post set the presale for Nov 16 to 19 and the auction for Nov 30, at 1 PM UTC. Any change is announced in advance.
points: Know the plan. Anything off plan: wait and check.

cards.title: Fake addresses in replies
cards.body: Scammers also post in the replies under real posts. They paste a fake contract address or a "backup link" and push it up with fake likes. Never copy an address or a link from replies. Wait, then check the announcement on a second official channel before you click anything.

questions.stem: The official X account posts a surprise mint link that closes in 20 minutes. What do you do?
options: Wait and check it on another official channel
Mint fast, the account is the real one
Ask in the replies if it is real
Mint with your vault to be careful
questions.why: Real accounts get hacked. A surprise link with a rush is the pattern. Check the other official channels before you click.

seg.label: Rush
seg.why: Pressure is there to stop you checking.

seg.label: Thanks
seg.why: Kind words are normal and prove nothing.

questions.why: A surprise change, a new link and a rush, even from the real server, means wait. Check X and the other official channels first.

questions.stem: A reply under the official post shares the presale contract address. What do you do?
options: Ignore it, never copy addresses from replies
Copy it, it has many likes
Use it if the account has a badge
Use it if two replies show the same one
questions.why: Scammers push fake addresses and links in reply threads under real posts. Likes and badges are easy to fake.

questions.stem: A friend says: "It came from the real account, so the link is fine." What do you tell them?
options: Real accounts get hacked, check another channel
True, a verified account cannot post scams
True, if the post also has many likes
True, hacks only happen to small projects
questions.why: The BAYC and OpenSea Discords were both taken over in 2022 to post fake links. A real account can be hacked, so check another official channel.

questions.stem: The official Discord posts a mint on a day that was never announced. What is the best move?
options: Treat it as a possible hack and check X
Mint fast, it may be a surprise bonus
DM a mod and ask for the real link
Share it so your friends do not miss it
questions.why: The official dates are presale Nov 16 to 19 and auction Nov 30. A surprise date is a reason to check another official channel.

seg.label: Too good price
seg.why: Far below the announced 0.029 ETH presale price.

seg.label: Rush
seg.why: A short timer is there to stop you checking.

questions.why: A price far below the announced 0.029 ETH presale, with a short timer, is too good. Wait and check another official channel.

questions.stem: The official Discord announcement channel posts a surprise mint pass link, and no mod has said anything. What do you do?
options: Wait, and check the official X account first
Mint now, only mods can post in announcements
Ask in general chat whether others have minted
Mint one pass first to test if it works
questions.why: In May 2022 a hacked OpenSea Discord posted a fake mint pass. Announcement channels can be taken over, so check another official channel first.

questions.stem: A post says only 10 minutes are left to mint. What should that rush tell you?
options: Slow down, urgency is a red flag
Hurry, real mints often sell out fast
Demand is high, so the project is real
Nothing, every mint has a countdown
questions.why: A rush exists to stop you checking. In the 2021 Animoca game hack, a surprise stealth mint took fees from 1,571 transactions in about three hours.

seg.label: Backup link
seg.why: A link from an unofficial account, not an official channel.

seg.label: Address from an unofficial account
seg.why: Never copy contract addresses from posts like this.

seg.label: Safety line
seg.why: A friendly line. Not the problem alone.

questions.why: Backup links and contract addresses posted by unofficial accounts are a classic trap. Check announcements only on the official channels themselves.

questions.stem: The official account posts the mint link on the planned date. What do you do before tapping it?
options: Find the same link on another official channel
Tap at once, the date matches the plan
Check the post has many likes and reposts
Ask in the replies if others minted fine
questions.why: Even on the right day, one channel can be hacked. A link that matches on two official channels is the one to bookmark.
